decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SA80208/SAP, SA80208/01,SA80208/02 and SA80208/04 received on 11/05/2016. Mission and Building Brief received on 01/07/2016. SA80208/03 received on 08/09/2016. Transport Statement ref. P1554: Salvation Army, Feltham produced by Paul Mew Associates received on 13/09/2016. Unilateral Undertaking made by The Salvation Army Trust Company and given to the London Borough of Hounslow received on 23/03/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for church and associated community centre purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 0900 - 2100 Monday to Friday and 0930 - 1830 Saturday and Sunday.

Condition : 5 - The community hall hereby approved (labelled 'community hall' on plan SA80208/03) shall not be used other than for purposes ancillary to the use of the premises as a church and community centre (Use Class D1) and in accordance with the Unilateral Undertaking made by The Salvation Army Trust Company and given to the London Borough of Hounslow received on 23/03/2017

Condition : 6 - Prior to the first beneficial use of the development hereby approved full details (including manufacturers specifications and access to the storage area) of secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than 4 bicycles) for the users of the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction
description: Erection of a single storey rear and part side extension
